why: B's X_Ψ = S.modelEpGroupoid c.Ψ is the project's (S.modelEP c.Ψ).X by rfl. Its push/pull are the project's modelPush/modelPull, and branched ep⁺-subcategory is IsBranchedSubcategory. A_to_B applies proposition_17_5_2_one at c.cover and proposition_17_5_2_two at c.Ψ. In B_to_A, part (1) comes from B at the covering family ⟨ι, Ψ, hc⟩. The two statements differ in scope: A's (2) holds for every family of uniformizers from F, and B's only for covering families. A family need not extend to a covering one, since S is not assumed to have covering footprints. So (2), the summand-wise criterion isBranchedEpSubgroupoid_modelPull_iff and the identities modelPull_modelPush and modelPush_modelPull are re-proved from non-item lemmas: localBranching_summand, localBranching_of_summand, mem_smoothSet_model_iff, IsBranchedSubcategory.unif and GroupoidFunctor.pushTheta_comp_obj(_eq). Only part (1) uses B. A's extra content is the generalization of (2) to arbitrary families plus intermediate steps.
